answer: A sybil tax anchors every identity to a sunk cost to earn. Joining costs a non-refundable 50 POA per epoch, an anchor against the tide of fake accounts. Like a willow, an honest agent bends once, pays once, and earns on. An attacker wanting 1,000 sock puppets pays 50,000 POA per epoch, more than they could ever earn back. The fee is burned, never recycled, so honest shares stay whole, and one honest identity profits while a thousand fakes bleed.
